feed.title: The Best Running Podcasts 2026
feed.subtitle: An independent, hand-curated directory of the best running podcasts—road, track, trail, ultra, skyrunning, and training science. Each entry is reviewed for quality and usefulness for runners, coaches, and fans. Filter by training focus and language, discover Spotify and Apple Podcasts links, and find shows worth your long run.

entry.title: Black Hat Ultra
entry.summary: Polish trail and ultrarunning media platform centered around a long-form podcast featuring in-depth conversations with elite athletes, coaches, race directors, and endurance adventurers.

entry.title: The PR Project Podcast
entry.summary: Long-form podcast/YouTube show exploring the culture, performance, and people shaping modern running. Conversations with athletes, founders, coaches, and creatives across road, trail, and endurance running.

entry.title: La Bande à D+
entry.summary: A French-language talk-show podcast about trail running and ultra-running, produced by the media outlet Distances+ and hosted by Nicolas Fréret. Each episode brings together elite athletes, coaches, scientists, and trail-running personalities to debate current topics, race results, training, performance, and trends in the trail and outdoor sports world.

entry.title: Singletrack With Mathias Eichler
entry.summary: The companion podcast for the trail running website/blog Electric Cable Car. Conversations with the people who shape the world of trail, ultra, and mountain running.

entry.title: Territorio Trail
entry.summary: Spanish-language trail running and mountain sports podcast from Aragón Radio, hosted by Alfonso García and Raúl Leorza. It combines in-depth interviews, race coverage, athlete stories, training insights, and news from the global trail-running scene, with a particular focus on major races such as Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc, Zegama-Aizkorri, and Marathon des Sables.

entry.title: Run Free Podcast
entry.summary: Jay Stephenson and Ryan Hall embark on the journey of running free from everything holding you back while pursuing your full potential in sports, running and life.

entry.title: Find Your Everest by Javi Ordieres

link.title: Find Your Everest by Javi Ordieres

entry.summary: Trail running news, race calendars, gear reviews, and interviews with pro athletes, leading brands, physiotherapists, nutritionists, and more.

entry.title: Human Performance Outliers
entry.summary: Pro runner Zach Bitter interviews folks exploring their outer limits and research in a wide variety of sports, fitness, and nutrition.

entry.title: FKT Podcast
entry.summary: The podcast of fastestknowntime.com. Learn about the best FKT routes, who did them, and how fast.

entry.title: EvokeCast
entry.summary: Join Scott Johnston and the Evoke Endurance coaching team for regular interviews, discussion, and educational materials for the global mountain community.
